title: 使用 Queenbee 前先确认客户授权
topic: 使用 Queenbee 前先确认客户授权

source.title: Our Internal Systems — Queenbee
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课展示《Our Internal Systems》的章节导言和完整 Queenbee 小节。练习重点是区分系统功能与授权边界：可以说明 Queenbee 的用途；以客户身份登录前必须先获得客户明确许可，不能预先登录。练习中的工单和账单问题为虚构情境。
paragraphs: Besides the customer-facing applications, like the different versions of Basecamp, we have a number of internal systems that help us support, report, and operate the company. They are as follows:
Queenbee is our invoice, accounting, and identity system. Here you can look up any customer account, see whether they are comped, refund an invoice, or even login as a customer.

That’s an immense amount of power and we take its use very seriously. We only ever login as a customer after having been given explicit permission to do so, never preemptively. Our customers expect that their information is confidential, even from us, and we intend to honor that expectation at all times.
translations: 除了 Basecamp 等面向客户的应用外，我们还有一些用于支持、汇报和运营公司的内部系统。下面介绍这些系统。
Queenbee 是我们的发票、会计和身份管理系统。你可以在这里查询客户账户、查看账户是否享有免费服务、退款，甚至以客户身份登录。
这项权限很大，我们非常认真地对待其使用。只有获得客户明确许可后，我们才会以客户身份登录，绝不会先行登录。客户期望他们的信息即使对我们也保密；我们会始终尊重这一点。

fullChapterParagraphs: Besides the customer-facing applications, like the different versions of Basecamp, we have a number of internal systems that help us support, report, and operate the company. They are as follows:
Queenbee is our invoice, accounting, and identity system. Here you can look up any customer account, see whether they are comped, refund an invoice, or even login as a customer.

That’s an immense amount of power and we take its use very seriously. We only ever login as a customer after having been given explicit permission to do so, never preemptively. Our customers expect that their information is confidential, even from us, and we intend to honor that expectation at all times.

We track programming exceptions on Sentry. When a customer hits a “Oops, something went wrong!” screen, that means there’ll be an entry in Sentry explaining to programmers why they saw that screen. Keeping the exceptions under control and monitored is primarily the responsibility of SIP and Jim via on-call.

We monitor our systems and their health through Grafana. Here you’ll find dashboards and alerting rules. It is our go-to for diagnosing performance issues, outages, and any other form for operational insight.

Dash is the main hub for everything that has to do with logging (like finding why a request is slow or whether an email has been delivered), reporting (everything from number of support cases handled to split of devices used to access Basecamp), application health (response times, job queue exceptions etc).
Omarchy is our new Linux distribution that everyone on Ops, SIP, and Ruby programmers on Product are moving to. We developed it in-house and continue to lead the development.

Kandji is how we make sure all work Mac laptops are securely configured and running the latest software updates. It helps us reduce our exposure to security incidents. You can read more about this in Managing work devices.

Shipshape is the OG in-house tool for ensuring your work Mac laptop is safe and secure. We still run it, but it’s gradually being superceded by Kandji. When you’re given access to the company’s GitHub account, you can run Shipshape to be sure you’re up to code. Shipshape will also test your machine periodically to let you know (and our SIP team know) if your machine springs a leak and needs bailing out.

notes.meaning: 发票、会计和身份管理系统

notes.example: Queenbee is our invoice, accounting, and identity system.

notes.explain: 来源列出 Queenbee 可查看账户和账单相关信息；以客户身份登录另有明确授权要求。

scenario.title: A teammate wants to use Queenbee’s customer-login option before asking permission
english: A support teammate wants to investigate a billing ticket by choosing “log in as a customer” in Queenbee.
The customer has not explicitly permitted anyone to log in as them.
You explain what Queenbee is for and state that the team must get explicit permission first and must not log in preemptively.
chinese: 一位客服同事想通过 Queenbee 的“以客户身份登录”功能调查一张账单工单。
客户尚未明确许可任何人以其身份登录。
你说明 Queenbee 的用途，并明确团队必须先取得客户授权，不能预先登录。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事想在客户授权前用 Queenbee 以客户身份登录，调查一张账单工单。请用英文说明 Queenbee 的用途、以客户身份登录前必须取得什么，以及为什么不能先登录再补授权。
firstAttempt.sample: Queenbee is our invoice, accounting, and identity system. We must get the customer’s explicit permission before logging in as them; we never log in preemptively. Their information must remain confidential, even from us.
firstAttempt.rationale: 回答需区分 Queenbee 的系统用途与客户授权条件，并说明不能预先登录的保密原因。

words.example: Queenbee shows whether a customer account is comped.
words.translation: Queenbee 会显示客户账户是否享有免费服务。
words.note: 来自 complimentary，指账户或服务免费提供。

words.example: We only log in as a customer after receiving explicit permission.
words.translation: 只有获得明确授权后，我们才会以客户身份登录。
words.note: 来源要求以客户身份登录前，先取得客户明确许可。

words.example: Never access an account as a customer preemptively.
words.translation: 绝不能预先以客户身份访问账户。
words.note: 在本句中指未获得客户明确许可前先行登录。

words.example: Customer information must remain confidential, even from us.
words.translation: 即使对我们来说，客户信息也必须保密。
words.note: 说明客户信息的保密边界。

structure.original: We only ever login as a customer after having been given explicit permission to do so, never preemptively.
analysis: We 是主语，only ever login as a customer 是“只有在……情况下才以客户身份登录”。
after having been given explicit permission 是完成式被动结构，强调明确授权必须先于登录。
never preemptively 是补充限制：绝不先登录后补授权。
structure.transfer: Before using Queenbee’s customer-login option for a billing ticket, confirm that the customer has explicitly permitted it. Do not log in in advance.

rewrite.bad: Use the customer-login option now to investigate the invoice; we can ask for permission later.
rewrite.good: Queenbee is our invoice, accounting, and identity system. We must get the customer’s explicit permission before logging in as them; we never log in preemptively. Their information must remain confidential, even from us.
rewrite.translation: Queenbee 是我们的发票、会计和身份管理系统。以客户身份登录前，我们必须先取得客户明确授权；绝不能预先登录。即使对我们来说，客户信息也必须保密。
rewrite.pattern: Before [logging in as a customer], get [the customer’s explicit permission]. Never [log in preemptively]; their information must remain [confidential].

cloze.prompt: We only log in as a customer after receiving explicit ___.
cloze.why: explicit permission 是来源规定的先决条件，授权必须在登录前取得。

cloze.prompt: We never log in as a customer ___.
cloze.why: preemptively 表示先行登录；来源明确说绝不预先登录。
confidential 表示保密；来源说客户期望信息即使对公司也保密。

dictation.text: We only ever login as a customer after having been given explicit permission to do so, never preemptively.

dictation.why: 抓住 after 和 never preemptively，确认授权先于登录。

apply.prompt: 同事想先登录查看客户账单，之后再联系客户。请用英文说明必须先做什么，并重申不能预先登录。
apply.sample: We need the customer’s explicit permission before logging in as them. We never log in preemptively.

translationPractice.prompt: 以客户身份登录前，我们必须先取得客户明确授权。
translationPractice.answer: We must get the customer’s explicit permission before logging in as them.
translationPractice.why: before 表明先取得授权；explicit permission 对应“明确授权”。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们绝不预先以客户身份登录。
translationPractice.answer: We never log in as a customer preemptively.
translationPractice.why: never ... preemptively 明确禁止未获授权就先行登录。

translationPractice.prompt: 即使对我们来说，客户信息也必须保密。
translationPractice.answer: Customer information must remain confidential, even from us.
translationPractice.why: remain confidential 表示持续保密；even from us 保留来源强调的范围。

choice.prompt: 同事想在客户明确授权前用 Queenbee 以客户身份查看账单。请选择符合手册要求的回复。
options: Log in now to see whether the billing issue is real, then ask the customer for permission.
We need the customer’s explicit permission before logging in as them. We never log in preemptively, because their information must remain confidential.
Anyone with access to Queenbee can log in as a customer without asking first.
choice.why: 正确项要求先取得客户明确授权，禁止先登录后补授权，并说明客户信息必须保密。

output.prompt: 一位同事想用 Queenbee 查看某客户是否享有免费服务，并提议先以客户身份登录、之后再补问授权。请用英文说明 Queenbee 可以做什么、客户身份登录前必须取得什么，并明确表示不能先登录。
output.sample: Queenbee can show whether a customer account is comped. But we must get the customer’s explicit permission before logging in as them. We never log in preemptively; their information must remain confidential.
check: 是否准确说明 Queenbee 可查看账户是否享有免费服务？
是否要求先取得客户明确授权？
是否明确禁止预先登录并说明保密原则？
